items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness Android app: control your DeepSeek Harness agents from your phone. The agent runs on your PC; a host plugin inside DSH pairs the phone by QR code over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, no cloud. Chats of all projects, live replies, photos and files, steer, agent questions, notifications. Unofficial, MIT.
items.desc_prev: Unofficial Android client for DeepSeek Harness: chats, tasks and live agent replies from your phone. The agent stays on your PC; pairing by QR code.
